subject: Dedicated privacy SKU — commit pricing & isolation premium clarification
messages:
From: Emma Lin <emma.lin@helios.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helios.ai>
Date: 2026-04-09T15:10:00-04:00
Subject: Dedicated privacy SKU: initial questions

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — the Dedicated offering looks promising for our use cases (PHI processing pipeline). Procurement here; Samir (CTO) is looped for technical items. A couple of quick clarifying questions before we share this with our security/compliance team: 

1) How do you price the "single-tenant" / privacy SKU versus standard Dedicated capacity? We need a line-item breakdown: base reserved GPU price, the isolation premium (either % or $/GPU), and any add-on costs (KMS/HSM integration, audit log retention beyond 90 days).

2) For SLA/throughput: can you share guaranteed tokens/sec per GPU (or an equivalent throughput SLA) and how that ties to commit sizing? We expect sustained inference on 8xA100-like workloads.

3) Contract length: Is there a discount schedule for 12 vs 24 month reserved commits and do you permit mid-term increases in commit size?

We'd like rough numbers to present to legal and security this week. If possible please attach a short term sheet or spreadsheet with scenarios (we're not asking for final legal language yet).

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Lin
Procurement Manager, Helios Analytics

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lin <emma.lin@helios.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helios.ai>
Date: 2026-04-10T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated privacy SKU: initial questions

Hi Emma — great to connect. Thanks for the clear list. Attached is a short response packet (Helios_RFP_response_v1.pdf) and a pricing scenarios workbook (dedicated_pricing_scenarios_0410.xlsx) with 3 committed-commit sizing options. High level summary below: 

- Base reserved commit (per-GPU, monthly): $1,900 / GPU / month (this is our standard Dedicated footprint pricing for 8xA100-equivalent configurations). Includes base monitoring, 30-day KV cache, and standard support.
- Single-tenant privacy premium: we offer two billing models — percentage uplift or flat per-GPU surcharge. Typical asks are either +20–30% uplift (most customers pick 25%) or a flat +$500 / GPU / month for fully isolated pools with tenant-dedicated network stack and tenant-only node placement. Workbook includes both variants.
- KMS integration (customer-managed keys): $2,000 / month flat for HSM/KMS connector + per-request key ops of $0.0002 / request. If you require on-prem HSM appliance integration we can price separately (depends on HSM vendor & porting).
- Audit logs & retention: 90 days included. Extended retention tiers: +$1,200 / month for 1 year retention; +$3,500 / month for 3 year retention and archival copies (immutable logs).
- Throughput SLA: we provide a per-deployment baseline of 10M tokens/day per GPU (sustained average) with 99.5% availability for reserved commits. For peak/latency-sensitive workloads we recommend burst pools or higher commit tiers; see sheet for token/sec equivalents.
- Term discounts: 12 months = 7% off base price, 24 months = 12% off base price (applies to base reserved commit only; premiums apply after base discounts).
- Scaling: you can increase commit mid-term; increases are prorated and effective immediately. Reductions are permitted at renewal only (30 days notice).

Quick call option: I'm free tomorrow 10–11 PT if you want to walk the numbers. Otherwise flagged a few items for internal review (CC'd): Stephanie (discount approvals) and Rishi (finance floor).

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attach: Helios_RFP_response_v1.pdf; dedicated_pricing_scenarios_0410.xlsx

From: Emma Lin <emma.lin@helios.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helios.ai>
Date: 2026-04-10T13:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated privacy SKU: initial questions

Thanks Camila — the sheet helps. A few follow-ups after a quick security/architecture read: 

- Can you split the isolation premium into the components that drive it? For auditors we'd like to show precise line items for: tenant-dedicated hypervisor/host placement, separate networking & VPC isolation, dedicated control-plane access, and enhanced logging/audit capabilities. Is the flat +$500 option a catch-all or can you provide the itemized breakdown?

- For KMS/HSM: we need to confirm FIPS 140-2 validation and support for AWS CloudHSM/Azure Dedicated HSM. If you have a vendor matrix or compatibility note that would be helpful.

- Throughput SLA: can you confirm the 10M tokens/day per GPU for 8xA100 is based on a 2048-context model with average token size ~4 characters? Our workloads vary; Samir, is that roughly what you expect?

Goal: if you can provide an itemized premium breakdown + a brief note on KMS vendors and an updated term sheet we can run this through our security/compliance gating next week.

—Emma

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lin <emma.lin@helios.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@helios.ai>
Date: 2026-04-11T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated privacy SKU: itemized premium breakdown & term sheet

Emma / Samir — looping in Stephanie and Rishi for approval on the pricing mechanics. Below is an itemized premium breakdown (we can also reflect this in a revised term sheet PDF):

Itemized isolation premium (per GPU / month):
- Tenant-dedicated host & placement: +$210 / GPU — reserved nodes exclusively scheduled to your tenant, dedicated NUMA placement and affinity rules.
- Dedicated networking & VPC isolation: +$120 / GPU — tenant-specific VPC peering, private egress, enhanced network ACLs.
- Control-plane access & audit scope: +$80 / GPU — tenant-scoped control plane endpoints, RBAC segregation, longer audit retention by default.
- Enhanced logging and immutable audit archives: +$90 / GPU — includes structured audit events and 90->365 day retention option (higher retention tier is additional fee as noted earlier).

Total itemized premium = +$500 / GPU / month (same as flat option in the workbook). If you prefer the percentage model we typically set it at 25% of the base committed price (today that maps to ~$475 on the base price). We can display both in the quote.

KMS/HSM compatibility: we support customer-managed keys with AWS KMS, AWS CloudHSM, Azure Key Vault + Dedicated HSM, and on-prem HSM vendors via PKCS#11 integration. Our connector is FIPS 140-2 compatible when provisioned with a validated HSM (final validation depends on the HSM vendor certificate; we include integration testing in onboarding). I'll attach a short vendor compatibility note to the term sheet.

Throughput SLA notes: the 10M tokens/day per GPU is a conservative sustained average based on our 2048-context benchmarks and a median tokenization profile of ~3.8 chars/token. For peak per-second guarantees we publish a guidance table in the workbook: typical observed steady-state throughput for the 8xA100-equivalent shape is ~85 tokens/sec per GPU for a medium-length request profile; latency-sensitive configs require burst pools or higher commit tiers.

Proposed commercial options (examples in attached redwood_dedicated_term_sheet_0411.pdf):
- Option A (Standard): 10 GPU reserved commit, 12-month term. Base price: $1,900/GPU/mo -> $1,767 after 7% term discount. Privacy premium: +$500/GPU -> total $2,267/GPU/mo. Effective monthly: $22,670.
- Option B (Enterprise): 20 GPU reserved commit, 24-month term. Base: $1,900 -> $1,672 after 12% discount. Privacy premium (negotiable): +$475/GPU (we can move to 25% in percentage model). With Stephanie/finance approval we can offer a one-time onboarding credit of $12k on 24-month commitments.

Action items:
- Emma: confirm if you prefer flat-per-GPU premium or % uplift for the quote.
- Samir: confirm KMS vendor preference (AWS/Azure/on-prem).
- Security: any additional gating items we should include in the SOW?

Stephanie / Rishi: would you be able to confirm the promotional onboarding credit and whether we can flex the premium to $475/GPU for a 24-mo, 20 GPU commit?

Thanks,
Camila

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Lin <emma.lin@helios.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@helios.ai>
Date: 2026-04-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated privacy SKU: itemized premium breakdown & term sheet

Camila — thanks for the clear breakdown. Approvals from GTM/Finance side:

- We can commit to the following concession for Helios: 24-month, 20 GPU reserved commit -> reduce isolation premium to $475/GPU (from $500) and apply a one-time onboarding credit of $12,000 applied against first invoice.
- Pricing floors: base per-GPU effective (post 24m discount) cannot go below $1,600/GPU/mo. This is non-negotiable.
- KMS add-on pricing stands as proposed. Any required HSM hardware integrations will be quoted separately and are out-of-scope of the standard term sheet.

Camila — please update the term sheet to reflect the 24m concession and send to Emma as a redlined PDF + DocuSign link. Legal will review the SOW language around audit log immutability and proof-of-deletion clauses once Helios returns a security questionnaire.

-S
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Emma Lin <emma.lin@helios.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@helios.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated privacy SKU: itemized premium breakdown & term sheet

Camila / Stephanie — appreciate the quick turnaround and the concession. Helios is comfortable moving forward in principle with the 24-month, 20 GPU commit and the $475/GPU privacy premium with the $12k onboarding credit. Next steps for us:

1) We'll send an updated vendor security questionnaire by EOD Monday for your legal/compliance to review.
2) Please send the final redlined term sheet and DocuSign link so we can begin internal approvals.

Samir: confirm if you want us to request any additional KMS vendor testing before signature.

Thanks all — expect the security questionnaire soon.

Best,
Emma
Procurement Manager, Helios Analytics
